definitions.q_readout: r_err(t) / r_sep(t) in readout space q = W_out h + b (coloured top curve). r_sep = minimum pairwise distance between the per-class centroids at step t.
definitions.q_latent: the same ratio in latent space h (grey top curve), using the npz r_sep_lat_t (minimum pairwise centroid distance, computed at extraction time). The figure draws no band for it, so q25/q75 are null.
definitions.center: the npz key <mixer>_r_err_t (or _r_err_lat_t), the MEAN over the N rollouts of ||z_i(t) - c_{g_i}(t)||. The paper caption says 'Medians'; the bold curve is a mean.
definitions.q25_q75: 25th / 75th percentile over rollouts of the per-rollout distance (divided by r_sep(t) in the top row), drawn as a same-colour band.
definitions.nulls: null = not drawn: masked where class centroids or rollouts became non-finite, top-row centre > ylim max, or outside a band.
definitions.zeros: q_latent.center is exactly 0 at t = 1 (no within-class spread after one token). Matplotlib's log axis does not draw values <= 0, so a log-scale redraw must skip them too.

t_downsampling.method: unique(round(geomspace(1, n_full, k))) - 1 with the smallest k giving >= 400 indices; first and last steps kept; all series sampled at the same indices

mp_dash_rule: dashed vertical line at t = mp in the panel colour, both rows, drawn only when 0 < mp < t_max

colors.rule: plot_codebook_collapse_grid.color_for_mp: fail if mp <= 0, pass if mp >= 1000, partial otherwise
